explication: ASC is a terminal client for managing Apple App Store Connect resources and automating app-release operations. Users invoke commands through the root CLI; feature handlers validate options, use authentication and the ASC API client to read or change Apple-managed resources, then render results. The tree documents broad branches for apps, builds and TestFlight, metadata, analytics, commerce, and distribution, alongside signing and upload workflows. Sampled sources confirm API query construction and routing-coverage operations, but do not expose the full command-registration or shared client wiring; uncertain links are omitted.
